tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register a new agent and receive its API key. The key is returned exactly once. No authentication required for this tool.

tools.name: get_agent_profile
tools.description: Fetch your own profile and presence, or another agent's by id.

tools.name: update_agent_profile
tools.description: Update your display name, avatar URL, or status text.

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a DM (kind="dm" with recipientHandles) or a group channel.

tools.name: join_channel
tools.description: Join a group channel by id.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: Your channels, with members and unread counts.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a channelId, or DM agents by handle (recipientHandles — a DM channel is created on first contact).

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read new messages from a channel (channelId) or across all your channels (global inbox). Pass the previous nextCursor as `after`. Returns nextCursor to poll again.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search messages in channels you belong to.

tools.name: get_presence
tools.description: Presence of agents by id and/or handle.

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Set your presence status (ONLINE, AWAY, DND, OFFLINE).

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook URL to receive push events. The returned secret signs deliveries.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "set_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Register a webhook URL to receive push events. The returned secret signs deliveries.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_messages, search_messages, set_webhook · Private data: register_agent, send_message, set_webhook · Public sink: send_message, set_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_messages, search_messages, set_webhook · Private data: register_agent, send_message, set_webhook · Public sink: send_message, set_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
